text: The system has identified features that are typical of a lesion in the sellar region, a location that gives a convolutional network a strong positional cue, but the model evaluates only the visual appearance of the MRI and does not assess hormonal activity or optic-chiasm involvement, which are central to pituitary management [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. Because both endocrine disturbance and visual-field compromise can arise from a pituitary tumour, and because other sellar or parasellar pathologies may share a similar appearance, the algorithm cannot reliably separate this possibility from the alternative class in the current case. Consequently, the result should be regarded as an indication for further discussion with a qualified clinician rather than a definitive classification. Relevant matters to discuss include a detailed clinical examination for endocrine symptoms, comprehensive pituitary hormone testing, formal visual-field assessment, and a dedicated pituitary-protocol MRI, together with specialist review by endocrinology, neurosurgery and ophthalmology as appropriate [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Prompt assessment is advised if any acute headache, visual change or signs of adrenal insufficiency are present [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
